issues: Does not read as a fox at a glance; looks like an abstract red blob
Floating/disconnected ear piece hovering off the model in front and right views
Sitting pose missing - build stands upright on two thick legs, no seated haunch or front legs
Tail is a small white/red wedge stuck to the side instead of a large curved bushy tail with white tip
Head not distinguishable from body; no muzzle, snout, or eye placement matching concept
Ears are grey/orange slabs pointing outward rather than upright black-tipped triangles
Dark red colour is too deep vs the bright orange-red of the concept
White chest/bib is fragmented and hidden rather than a large smooth front panel
Black paws only vaguely present as dark ankle blocks
Messy stud exposure and gaps; not official-set quality
distilled: A LEGO model of a chunky sitting fox with a bushy stacked tail curled at its side, built from stacked bricks and plates with a curved slope back and pointed ear details.
